newsitem.title: USA: AT&T sees Q1 earnings same, slightly above Q4.
newsitem.headline: AT&T sees Q1 earnings same, slightly above Q4.

text.p: AT&T Corp on Wednesday said that it expected first quarter 1997 earnings to be about the same or slightly better than the fourth quarter of 1996, and added it would begin buying its own shares in the market.

"We expect the recent revenue expense and capital spending trends to continue into the first quarter producing earnings that are comparable to or slightly above those of the fourth quarter of 1996," Chief Financial Officer Richard Miller said.
The company reported operating earnings per share of $0.76 for the fourth quarter from $0.68 a year ago.

"However, uncertainty still exists regarding our spending rates for new initiatives and local entry as well as possible RBOC (regional Bell) entry into long distance and the required competitive response," Miller told a conference call.
He said the company would give more guidance in March.
Miller said that AT&T's purchase of shares in the open market would help to restrain the increase in average shares outstanding, but gave no hint of how large purchases would be.
Weighted average shares outstanding rose to 1.625 billion at the year end from 1.602 billion a year earlier.
